leads.title: Council commissions
leads.detail: Rolf says to read the proclamations at City Hall and ask the clerk about commissions.

leads.title: Training in New Phlan
leads.detail: Rolf showed the party where adventurers train. Return to the training schools when a character is ready to advance.

leads.title: Paid lodging in New Phlan
leads.detail: The lodging on the south side of New Phlan costs one platinum. Pay for a stay to rest and memorize spells.

leads.title: The sea lanes
leads.detail: Rolf says few ships risk the passage and the council wants to reopen it.

leads.title: Training school directions
leads.detail: From the notices, go north to train magic users or clerics. Go east to train fighters or rogues.

leads.title: Doors at the northern training school
leads.detail: From the sign, use the east door for magic users and the west door for clerics.

leads.title: Cleric training door
leads.detail: Use the west door at the northern training school. Accept the trainer's offer, select the cleric, then choose Train Character.

leads.title: Training costs 1,000 gold
leads.detail: The trainer quoted a fee of 1,000 gold. Check the selected character's coins and experience under View Character before returning.

leads.title: More experience needed
leads.detail: The trainer refused advancement for lack of experience. Earn more XP and check the character's progress under View Character.

leads.title: Healing at the Temple of Sune
leads.detail: Priestess Joy of Sune offers healing in New Phlan.

leads.title: Fetch Ohlo's potion - turned in
leads.detail: Ohlo drank his potion and settled the reward.

leads.title: The Rope Guild entrance
leads.detail: The party found the notice just north of the entrance to the Old Rope Guild.

leads.title: The Old Rope Guild
leads.detail: The party entered the former Rope Guild in the Slums.

leads.title: The Rope Guild booth
leads.detail: The man in the booth says he has nothing to sell.

leads.title: The Rope Guild package
leads.detail: The booth merchant gave the party a package after hearing Ohlo's name. Bring it back to Ohlo.

leads.title: Ohlo drank the potion
leads.detail: Ohlo drank the potion, grew younger, and offered the promised reward.

leads.title: Proclamation LXIV
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation LXXVIII
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation CIX
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Proclamation LIX
leads.detail: The party recorded this council proclamation. Its text is in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Clear the Slums - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Clear Sokal Keep - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Recover records of old Phlan - offered
leads.detail: Search the old city for historical records and bring worthwhile finds to the clerk.

leads.title: Investigate the auction - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Adventuring partners in New Phlan
leads.detail: The arena master can introduce adventurers who take a share of the party's treasure.

leads.title: Fighter training door
leads.detail: Go east past the arena in New Phlan, then take the north door marked Fighters. Accept the trainer's offer and select Train Character.

leads.title: Passage to Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The harbor master says you can reach the keep by boat.

leads.title: Arrival at Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The party landed on Thorn Island.

leads.title: Reeds by the keep gate
leads.detail: The party saw a mound of reeds west of the gates.

leads.title: The parchment at Sokal Keep
leads.detail: The party found a damaged scroll on a dead elf outside the keep.

leads.title: Sokal Keep patrol
leads.detail: The undead patrol accepted the word and let the party pass.

leads.title: Sokal courtyard ambush
leads.detail: A large force of orcs and hobgoblins rushed the party through the courtyard door.

leads.title: Note from the courtyard
leads.detail: The party found a note on a fallen hobgoblin and copied it as journal entry 57.

leads.title: Journal entry 57
leads.detail: The party encountered a reference to entry 57 in the Adventurer's Journal.

leads.title: Sokal Keep chapel
leads.detail: The party found the remains of two orcs in the doorway and a large altar against the south wall.

leads.title: The keep's pale figure
leads.detail: A pale figure appeared inside the keep. The party can try speaking to it.

leads.title: Ferran Martinez
leads.detail: Ferran is bound to guard the keep and asks whether Phlan has been freed.

leads.title: Ferran's account of Phlan's fall
leads.detail: Ferran said creatures empowered by a magical pool overran Phlan. He named Tyranthraxus, Edranka, and Torath as their leaders.

leads.title: Mendor's lost histories
leads.detail: Ferran says Mendor gathered accounts of the powers that brought down Phlan. His library was overrun.

leads.title: Sokal Keep armory
leads.detail: Ferran says help lies beyond an illusory wall in the armory.

leads.title: Ferran's password
leads.detail: Ferran told the party to say SAMOSUD to his guards on the way out.

leads.title: Boat back from Thorn Island
leads.detail: The party found a boat returning to New Phlan at the south pier.

leads.title: Back in New Phlan
leads.detail: The party returned to New Phlan with the Sokal Keep report.

leads.title: Healing at the Temple of Tyr
leads.detail: The priests at the Temple of Tyr in New Phlan offer healing.

leads.title: Recover Cadorna's treasure - accepted
leads.detail: Go to the textile complex south of Podal Plaza. Search the western building for Cadorna's treasure.

leads.title: The harbor routes are open
leads.detail: The harbor master offers passage east, west, back to Sokal Keep, and to the north side of the bay.

leads.title: Return ferry to New Phlan
leads.detail: Choose Take Boat at the dock to return to the civilized part of Phlan.

leads.title: The crowd at Podal Plaza
leads.detail: The party can disguise itself as monsters or sneak past the crowd.

leads.title: The auction has begun
leads.detail: The auctioneer announced a powerful magical item to the crowd.

leads.title: An approach to the auction
leads.detail: The party chose how to cross the crowd at Podal Plaza.

leads.title: The high bid
leads.detail: A man in plain clothes standing next to an ogre bid 5,000 gold pieces.

leads.title: The ogre had no item
leads.detail: The ogre was tackled and searched after fleeing the auction. He did not have the item.

leads.title: Follow up with the Temple of Tyr - offered
leads.detail: Speak with Bishop Braccio at Tyr's temple about his summons.

leads.title: Clear Kovel Mansion - turned in
leads.detail: The council acknowledged the result.

leads.title: Thieves in Kovel Mansion
leads.detail: Two thieves fled through the east door after their attack failed.

leads.title: The thieves split up
leads.detail: One ran east and the other ran south.

leads.title: Mansion ambush
leads.detail: Thieves attacked the party inside the mansion.

leads.title: Mansion ambush cleared
leads.detail: The party defeated the thieves who set the ambush.

leads.title: End the graveyard menace - accepted
leads.detail: Take the clerk's enchanted weapon to Valhingen Graveyard and investigate the source of the attacks.

leads.title: Investigate the nomad camp - offered
leads.detail: Find the nomads, prevent their alliance with the enemy, and bring the news back.

leads.title: Stop kobold reinforcements - offered
leads.detail: Find the recruited tribe and prevent it from joining the enemy. Report to the clerk.

leads.title: Thief training door
leads.detail: Go east past the arena to the north door marked Rogues, next to the fighter school. Accept the trainer's offer, select the thief, then choose Train Character.

leads.title: Magic-user training door
leads.detail: Use the east door at the northern training school. Accept the trainer's offer, select the magic user, then choose Train Character.

leads.title: The kobold cave fork
leads.detail: The party found a concealed cave beside a larger entrance and can choose which to explore.
